scope.selectedAcceptance: 62 actual CLI/filesystem migration tests; not whole-compiler acceptance.
threeDistinctGroups: Untouched independently emitted legacy directories, observed with their actual failures.
Explicit test-only shared legacy-support assembly with original component/map bytes and static facades; not untouched old directories.
New directories produced by the actual migrate-native-support CLI.
additionalControls: Deliberately duplicated full helper with shared ownership; only the recorded facade and two helper copies differ.
limits: No full compiler, browser, hydration, all-backend or performance acceptance is inferred.
Existing unrelated generated strict and Text failures are not claimed fixed by these 62 tests.

normalization.status: Normalized derivative, not original evidence bytes.
rules: Every distinct temporary fixture root receives one stable distinct <fixture-NNN> token across all documents. Relative esbuild paths to that root receive the same token.
Dependency installation roots become <locked-dependencies>; repository roots become <repo>. Module-relative paths, package IDs and all other project data remain unchanged.

Normalization applies to object keys and string values, including nested CLI JSON stdout strings. Original record SHA256 and byte length are retained. Internal occurrence-aware reversal reconstructs each original JSON file byte-for-byte.
normalization.omitted: No bundle code, broad legacy helper bodies, execution receipts/logs, process data or supervision records are included.
